verdict: Leads dropped sharply this week; Meta is holding, Google spend collapsed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 130 leads at a cost of $19.85 per lead, all delivered through Meta — Google was active but recorded no attributed leads this period. In the most recent 7 days, lead volume fell 50% and spend dropped 35%, driven almost entirely by Google's budget being cut nearly in half; Meta's cost per lead has held steady but is now carrying the full load alone. The sharp drop in activity over August 15–17 confirms this is a real pullback, not day-to-day fluctuation. Google's conversion tracking is being repaired so its contribution can be accurately measured, and dedicated landing pages go live by August 31 to support both channels. Next period you should expect clearer attribution from Google and a steadier daily lead pace as those pages come online.
